description: Reduced input template after canonical accounting moves standalone torsion-curvature and bundle-index effects into the selected index-weighted local determinant response.

canonical_accounting.local_determinant: The one live term: selected, index-weighted, torsion-dependent determinant/analytic-torsion response in the fixed gauge-factor basis.
canonical_accounting.torsion_curvature: No standalone non-universal amplitude. Direct gravitational/torsion curvature is universal; gauge-dependent torsion effects enter through the determinant operator.
canonical_accounting.bundle_index: No standalone amplitude. Group/Dynkin/charge indices weight the determinant; without a spectrum or determinant they do not define a threshold value.
canonical_accounting.scheme_counterterm: Zero in the canonical no-finite-nonuniversal-counterterm matching scheme.
canonical_accounting.basis_transport: Zero in the fixed (U1,SU2,SU3) gauge-factor basis.

remaining_required_data: selected index-weighted local determinant response vector, or only its U1-SU2 difference
